rows: Whether ingestion breadth is the hard part
Connectors and scheduling help, but schema drift and integration runtime ownership remain.
Whether transformations need complex Spark ecosystem
Databricks usually has stronger ecosystem; Synapse may fit Azure-integrated estates.
Whether lake data needs ad hoc SQL
Pay-per-scan rewards partitioning and file pruning; sloppy layout becomes cost.
Whether repetitive SQL needs predictable performance
Dedicated capacity should pause when idle or it burns money.
Whether ML needs training plus experiment tracking
Split ownership carefully: notebooks, registry, deployment, and governance can fragment.
Whether sharing crosses clouds or companies
Snowflake, or Azure Data Share for simpler Azure cases
Data sharing is also contract, lineage, and access governance.
Whether lineage/governance is the missing layer
Scanning tools need naming, ownership, and stewardship processes to be useful.
Whether the lake needs ACID table semantics
ACID helps reliability but does not fix bad partitioning or modeling.
Whether streams should land in the lake in near-real time
Event Hubs plus Spark Streaming, or Stream Analytics to ADLS
Streaming pipelines need replay, watermarking, and backpressure design.
